# Selimoglu Idea Foundry

> Selimoglu Idea Foundry is an independent software and R&D atelier exploring AI review, privacy, documents and practical tools.

## Website
- [English](https://selimoglu.org/): Project collection, real interface screenshots, public demos and source links.
- [Türkçe](https://selimoglu.org/tr/): Projeler, gerçek ekran görüntüleri, canlı demolar ve kaynak bağlantıları.
- [Project source on GitHub](https://github.com/ufodia): Repositories for the public projects linked from this website.

## Public projects
- [Decision Recheck](https://github.com/ufodia/decision-recheck): Compare a product promise with its requirements and evidence, then inspect the decision from different perspectives.
- [IntentWeft](https://github.com/ufodia/intentweft): A portable local skill for reviewing intent, evidence and verification in AI-assisted code changes, with a Python helper.
- [Sheet Sentry](https://github.com/ufodia/sheet-sentry): Inspect changes to spreadsheet formulas and values after AI edits, with before-and-after context.
- [CutOnce](https://github.com/ufodia/cutonce): Plan rectangular pieces on irregular material and inspect a proposed cutting layout.
- [Agent Crash Lab](https://github.com/ufodia/agent-crash-lab): Explore how a simulated workflow responds to a failure under different recovery policies.
- [Handrail](https://github.com/ufodia/handrail): A browser extension that guides user actions through a recorded sequence, while the user stays in control.
- [Boss Rehearsal](https://github.com/ufodia/boss-rehearsal): Turn gameplay clips into decision and timing drills.
- [Fact Fuse](https://github.com/ufodia/fact-fuse): Review changed numbers, dates, links and promises in AI rewrites.
- [Invented Detail](https://github.com/ufodia/invented-detail): Examine added detail and disagreements in photo restoration.
- [LocaleCrash](https://github.com/ufodia/locale-crash): Explore English and Turkish regressions in structured-output parsing.
- [Paper Surgery](https://github.com/ufodia/paper-surgery): Repair PDF reading order and extracted text before using them with AI.
- [Memory Mirror](https://github.com/ufodia/memory-mirror): Review sensitive details in AI chat exports locally.
- [Venturemorph](https://github.com/ufodia/venturemorph): A portable AI skill that revisits product, growth and brand decisions as evidence changes.
- [Formsemble](https://github.com/ufodia/formsemble): A product-aware design skill for carrying interface work from current behavior through implementation to an honest review.
- [Demandweft](https://github.com/ufodia/demandweft): A buyer-question-to-proof skill for building a useful decision aid and learning without forcing a sale or a share.

## GitHub community favourites
- [BTC-PUZZLE](https://github.com/ufodia/BTC-PUZZLE): A CPU-based search tool for Bitcoin puzzle keyspaces.
- [bitcoin-public-key-to-private-key](https://github.com/ufodia/bitcoin-public-key-to-private-key): An elliptic-curve arithmetic experiment with limited random candidate search; not a general private-key converter.
- [Token-Buy-Tracker-TelegramBot](https://github.com/ufodia/Token-Buy-Tracker-TelegramBot): A Python Telegram bot for monitoring token buys using external services and configured credentials.
- [Bitcoin-Keyhound](https://github.com/ufodia/Bitcoin-Keyhound): An exploratory Python toolkit for ECDSA signature and nonce analysis.
- [Bitcoin-Puzzle-Address-Generator](https://github.com/ufodia/Bitcoin-Puzzle-Address-Generator): Generates toy Bitcoin address puzzles; not a secure wallet generator.
- [auto-py-to-exe](https://github.com/ufodia/auto-py-to-exe): A fork of brentvollebregt/auto-py-to-exe: a PyInstaller-based GUI for packaging Python scripts.
- [Bitcoin-Private-Key-Predictor](https://github.com/ufodia/Bitcoin-Private-Key-Predictor): A historical TensorFlow experiment; it does not demonstrate real private-key prediction or recovery.


## Context
The website labels conceptual artwork separately from real project screenshots. Hosted demos use examples; IntentWeft and Venturemorph are portable skills with setup links. Project panels explain limitations. This file is a concise navigation aid, not a guarantee of indexing or AI citation.
